Deep cobalt blue reserved for the primary CTA and active state, warm copper used sparingly for price and highlight moments, on a cool stone-grey surface — never cream, never green, never glass. Newsreader serif for display headlines with Amiri for Arabic display, IBM Plex Sans / IBM Plex Sans Arabic for body — full bilingual RTL support, not an afterthought.
